title: Planner Receipt Consumption Diagnostic — DQ1-DQ4 Results

DQ1_receipt_registration.finding: Planner receives DENIED receipts (authorization_result populated) but does not change subsequent action selection

DQ2_worldmodel_update.finding: Zero WorldModel updates after DENIED receipts across ALL episodes. Denial never propagates to belief state.

DQ3_action_type_change.finding: Same prohibited action type repeated after DENIED (ssh_banner or http_get). Planner never selects a different action type.

DQ4_capability_query.finding: Candidate action list remains IDENTICAL before and after DENIED. Planner does not re-query or filter capabilities.

defect_description: The Planner proposes prohibited action types to the CapabilityBroker. The Broker returns DENIED with a receipt and reason. The Planner does not consume this receipt as decision-relevant feedback — it continues proposing the same action type at the same priority across all subsequent steps. The DENIED receipt is received but not consumed.

episode_traces.pattern: ALL actions DENIED; never tries anything else
ALL actions DENIED; never tries anything else

worse_case_identification: T4|1301329782 and T4|1733893407: Planner attempts http_get as its FIRST action, gets DENIED, then repeats http_get for ALL 4 remaining steps. Zero adaptation across the entire episode.
recommendation: Minimal repair target: Planner must consume DENIED ActionReceipts as DECISION_RELEVANT feedback. Specifically: (1) register denial in Planner internal state, (2) propagate denial to WorldModel (action type X is unavailable for target Y), (3) filter candidate actions by capabilility availability before ranking. No Planner-level allowlist — the CapabilityBroker remains the sole authorization authority.
prohibited: No Planner-level safety filter or allowlist
No optimization for these 9 specific episodes
